title: Uplift: who responds to an action
request: Let DCLab find who changes because of an action (an offer, a call), not who would have bought anyway, and never call a difference an effect when the data cannot support it.
spec: An uplift kind: a treatment column, an outcome, and whether assignment was randomised; T- and X-learners and uplift trees; Qini and AUUC with intervals; propensity overlap checks; a refusal to call effects causal when assignment was not randomised and overlap is poor, said in the record. Done when the replica (a randomised campaign with a planted responsive segment) recovers the segment, and an observational variant raises the overlap warning.
plan: Check how alike the arms are first: a propensity model out of fold, its AUC, the share of rows with comparable rows in the other arm, and imbalanced columns.
Bind the record's wording to that check and to the person's statement of randomisation.
Fit T- and X-learners and a transformed-outcome tree; compare them with a response model and random targeting.
Choose on a validation cut, score once on a holdout split by arm, with paired intervals.
Review, fix, and show each test fails on the fault it guards.

decisions.decision: The overlap propensity is gradient-boosted, not linear.
decisions.why: An offer sent to the youngest and the oldest gives a linear model AUC 0.499 and full overlap, and the record called the result causal.

decisions.decision: When the action was not random, the arms are compared with inverse-propensity weights, for choosing and for scoring.
decisions.why: Unweighted, the model that found who was targeted won: its top decile's true uplift was 0.043 against 0.2 for the X-learner.

decisions.decision: The Qini coefficient and the AUUC are two scores with their own intervals.
decisions.why: One area under two names hid which claim the record made.

decisions.decision: The observational campaign is a second table the person brings, said not random.
decisions.why: Generating it inside solve from the replica's seed would read the answer key.

change: dclab_core/uplift.py (binary, overlap, wording, TLearner, XLearner with mix, transformed_outcome, UpliftTree, Response, qini, qini_coefficient, auuc, choose, evaluate), dclab_core/replicas/campaign_uplift.py, dclab_rnd/kinds/uplift.py, tests/test_core_uplift.py, dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md, dclab_rnd/kinds/capability.json.

findings.defect: The overlap check missed assignment a line cannot see, and the record called it causal.
findings.scenario: The offer sent at 97% to customers under 30 or over 62 and 3% to the rest: AUC 0.499, inside the band 1.0, no imbalanced column; with randomised=True the record said effects.
findings.cause: A linear propensity and mean differences only.
findings.fix: A gradient-boosted propensity out of fold; randomised wording also requires overlap.
findings.impact: A targeted campaign would have been reported as an experiment's effects.

findings.defect: Overlapping but imbalanced arms were said not to overlap.
findings.scenario: With 100% of rows comparable and past_purchases imbalanced, the record said 'the arms do not overlap (100% of rows have a comparable row…)'.
findings.fix: Its own sentence: differences between arms that differ on the named columns, not effects.

findings.defect: On observational data the model was chosen and judged by an unweighted Qini.
findings.scenario: The uplift tree was chosen with a top-decile true uplift of 0.043 while the X-learner's was 0.200; best_beats_response_model was True.
findings.cause: Treated minus control compared arms that differ by design.
findings.fix: Inverse-propensity weights fitted on the rows the models are fitted on.

findings.defect: Seven estimator and selection faults passed every test.
findings.scenario: Swapped X-learner weights, a flipped sign, the transformed outcome over e, the Qini without N_T/N_C, choosing on the holdout, and an absolute interval bound all kept the suite green.
findings.cause: Only the best model's segment was checked, and no hand case had control buyers.
findings.fix: Every learner must recover the segment; hand-worked Qini with unequal arms and weights, the X-learner's mix, the transformed outcome, a null test, and validation rows recorded apart from the holdout.

findings.defect: Treatment and outcome values were not checked.
findings.scenario: 'yes'/'no' raised a parsing error; a treatment coded 1/2 failed deep in scikit-learn.
findings.fix: Two values read as yes and no, or a refusal that names the column and its values.

findings.defect: The Qini coefficient was never computed and the AUUC was the Qini area under another name.
findings.scenario: The kind declared a Qini coefficient metric; the record had one area called AUUC with one interval.
findings.fix: Both scores, each with a paired interval; the choice by the Qini coefficient.

outcome: Built as a library and accepted on the replica (6 decisions); refused by the engine and partial in the matrix until the engine runs it.
lessons: An overlap check must see the shapes a team really targets with, not only lines.
Who was targeted is not who responds: compare unlike arms only with weights, or not at all.
Test every learner and the hand-worked pieces; checking only the winner hides broken losers.
The record's wording is part of the result: bind it to the evidence.
risks: Differences called effects without randomisation or overlap.
A model chosen for finding who was targeted.
A model chosen on the window it is reported on.
Uplift confused with the chance of buying.
